items.title: Should Coca-Cola’s (KO) Reaffirmed Dividend Shape Its Role as a Long-Term Income Anchor?
items.summary: Coca-Cola recently declared a regular quarterly dividend of US$0.53 per common share, payable on October 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 15, 2026. This dividend affirmation, alongside expectations for year-over-year revenue and earnings growth in the upcoming Q2 2026 results, underscores Coca-Cola’s continued emphasis on income generation and operating resilience. items.title: WPP’s sweeping restructure could save £500 million—the bigger challenge might be winning over workers
items.summary: The advertising giant is simplifying its structure as it aims to arrest its decline. Chief people officer Marie-Claire Barker says the harder task is rebuilding trust, changing leadership behavior, and creating a unified culture across its 90,000 employees.

items.title: 1 S&P 500 Stock for Long-Term Investors and 2 We Turn Down
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.
